meta.title: Mark — Personal Site Publisher Mode
meta.description: Try Daymark in a throwaway WordPress. Lands in the /daymark app shell, logged in as admin.
meta.author: jeffpaul

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$plugin = Daymark_Plugin::instance();

foreach ( [ 'https://jeffpaul.com', 'https://jondesrosiers.com', 'https://aaron.jorb.in' ] as $site_url ) {
	$result = $plugin->subscriptions->subscribe_to_site( $site_url );
	if ( ! is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
		$plugin->subscription_poller->poll_subscription( (int) $result );
	}
}

$featured_mark_id = $plugin->publisher->publish(
	array(
		'title'        => 'Featured Content demo',
		'caption'      => 'Demo of Featured Content: this Mark uses a YouTube video as its featured video instead of an image.',
		'primary_type' => 'note',
	)
);

if ( ! is_wp_error( $featured_mark_id ) ) {
	update_post_meta( $featured_mark_id, '_daymark_featured_content_type', 'video' );
	update_post_meta(
		$featured_mark_id,
		'_daymark_featured_content',
		wp_json_encode( array( 'video' => array( 'source' => 'url', 'url' => 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BZtL1NVlxgQ' ) ) )
	);
}
